attributes.board_name: Iowa Board of Physical and Occupational Therapy (Department of Inspections, Appeals, and Licensing)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Workshops, conferences, symposia; online training and webinars; full-time clinical student supervision (1 h per 160 h, max 8); presenting (2 h per hour, first offering); academic courses (semester hour 15, trimester 12, quarter 10); first-time college teaching; publications (5 h per page); professional organization service (1 h per 6 months, max 4). Business, personal-skills and general health topics (incl. CPR and mandatory reporter training) max 8 hours combined.
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE for the first renewal; hours earned from initial licensure until the second renewal may be used.
rules.carryover: Up to 50% of the requirement (max 15 hours) may be applied to the next renewal period.
rules.audit_note: The board audits licensees for CE and mandatory-training compliance; keep certificates and training records (training records 3 years).

topics.who: Licensees who are mandatory reporters of child abuse (Iowa Code 232.69) and/or dependent adult abuse (235B.3, 235E.2): Iowa HHS curriculum completed within the previous 3 years, indicated on the renewal application

rules.notes: Biennial period runs from the 16th day of the birth month to the 15th day of the birth month two years later. Rules moved from 645 IAC ch. 206 to 481 IAC ch. 805 (effective July 1, 2024; amended Aug 13, 2025).

rules.accepted_credit_types: Same activity types as OTs; student supervision max 4; business, personal-skills and general health topics (incl. CPR and mandatory reporter training) max 4 hours combined.
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE for the first renewal; hours earned from initial licensure until the second renewal may be used.
rules.carryover: Up to 50% of the requirement (max 7.5 hours) may be applied to the next renewal period.
rules.audit_note: The board audits licensees for CE and mandatory-training compliance.

topics.who: Licensees who are mandatory reporters of child and/or dependent adult abuse: Iowa HHS curriculum within the previous 3 years

rules.notes: Biennial period runs from the 16th day of the birth month to the 15th day of the birth month two years later.
